text:
A simple illustration of a cinematic montage with a double exposure effect, in the style of a poster: the composition features a close-up of the face of a pensive, dark-haired young warrior in his twenties, clad in a futuristic battle suit, against the backdrop of a nighttime metropolis. The male character is dangerously handsome, with an elegant appearance. He has a handsome face with a sharply defined, rugged chin. He has short-cropped black hair, piercing steely eyes, and an intelligent and attentive gaze. His expression is elusive, a half-smile concealing cynicism and charm, mixed with multi-layered scenes around the central figure:
a large close-up anthropomorphic gray male panther in a black futuristic battle suit, view 3/4; two mercenary fighters stand in different poses in full black steel combat gear.
The general background: a nighttime metropolis with skyscrapers, the composition below is in complete darkness. The combination of cold lighting, shallow depth of field, double exposure effect, very soft imperceptible transitions between scenes, smoothly flowing into each other, nostalgic mood, 4K, smooth transitions, fabulous atmosphere.
